create_sparsify24: create a 2:4 sparse tensor from a dense input tensor using sparsify24 with configurable gradient and backend
create_sparsify24_ste: create a 2:4 sparse tensor with straight-through estimator gradient for the backward pass
create_sparsify24_like: create a 2:4 sparse tensor from a dense input using an existing sparse tensor pattern
build_sparse24_matmul: build a sparse matrix multiplication using Sparse24TensorCutlass or Sparse24TensorCuSparseLt backends
test_cusparse_lt_availability: test whether cuSPARSELt backend is available for sparse24 operations on the current GPU
